extension.description: A configurable video add-on for Kodi. Browse categories, search, keep favorites and a resume-aware watch history, and play from a content source you configure. Content-source agnostic: point it at your own JSON API or HTML source.
extension.news: v1.0.2 - Adaptive streaming (HLS/DASH via InputStream Adapter) with optional DRM and a quality picker; TTL response caching and network retries; skin widget endpoints and a Test Connection button. v1.0.1 - Latest-Kodi compatibility: use the InfoTag API on Kodi 20+ (Nexus/Omega) with a Kodi 19 fallback; drop the unused beautifulsoup4 dependency. v1.0.0 - Initial release: categories, search, favorites, history, pagination, settings.

extension.summary: Install and update the Cumnation add-on
extension.description: Repository for the Cumnation video add-on. Add this to receive Cumnation and its updates directly inside Kodi.
